# Weekly settlement status

This report repeats the same status for every week of the quarter. It is
long, and it is redundant: every week says the same thing about the same
settlement rounding rule, in the same words.

## Week 1

Settlement ran clean this week. The rounding rule applied as documented
and no bet required manual correction. Nothing changed.
